name: Invincible class
axes: right-handed: X longitudinal/bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse

reference.configuration: G3 principal arrangement checked against Admiralty NPD1255: two forward triple turrets, bridge, third triple turret amidships and machinery/funnels aft. Simplified external structures and secondary positions are original interpretations; this is not a facsimile of the Admiralty plan. The campaign Invincible variant adds its fitted stern catapult and AA; the two submerged torpedo tubes are internal and are not exposed deck mounts.
reference.note: Equipment stations follow the existing shared-geometry recognition drawing. Hull and superstructure are simplified into cuboids. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
